About HireSetu

About HireSetu Career Intelligence

HireSetu is a career intelligence platform built because job search in India is fragmented, noisy, and full of low-quality listings. We help candidates discover verified openings, research companies, and apply with better resumes — with transparent sourcing and practical tools.

Last updated: August 10, 2026

Our mission

HireSetu's mission is to make career discovery trustworthy and practical — so candidates can find real employer openings, understand how industries actually hire, prepare with clarity, and apply with stronger materials.

We exist to reduce noise in the Indian job market: fewer fake consultancy posts, clearer paths from learning to applying, and tools that respect candidate time.

Founder & operator

HireSetu is owned and operated by Prashanth Jakkula, based in Telangana, India. I built HireSetu after seeing how candidates jump between aggregator boards, WhatsApp forwards, and company career pages without a single trustworthy view of what is actually open.

Day-to-day work covers product engineering, job listing review, Career Insights editorials, and candidate tools such as AI Resume Optimizer. We are not a staffing consultancy and we do not sell candidate data as job leads.

Career Insights articles use the byline “HireSetu Editorial Team” because they are produced and reviewed through the same operator-led workflow described in our Editorial Policy. There is no separate ghostwriting team or paid contributor network.

The problem we solve

Candidates today jump between company career sites, aggregator boards, LinkedIn posts, and WhatsApp hiring messages. Many listings are stale, duplicated, or posted by unverified consultancies. Meanwhile, students and freshers struggle to learn what employers actually expect beyond college syllabi and certificate courses.

HireSetu solves this by combining employer-sourced job discovery with company research and application tools — so people can find real openings, understand employers, and tailor a resume without guessing which boards to trust.

What HireSetu does

HireSetu helps candidates discover and understand employment opportunities — with organized job pages, company hiring signals, career articles, and tools such as AI Resume Optimizer. We focus on useful candidate context, not on pretending to be the employer.

Where opportunities come from

Opportunities may be identified from official company career pages, public hiring announcements, recruiter or company posts, professional networking sources, and other legitimate public recruitment sources — including many employer systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, Oracle, Lever, and SuccessFactors where publicly available.

HireSetu uses technology-assisted job discovery followed by manual selection, review, enrichment, and publication. We do not automatically publish every discovered opportunity, and we do not claim that every job is independently verified from scratch.

Read the full workflow on How HireSetu Works and our Editorial Policy.

Relationship with employers

Unless explicitly stated otherwise, HireSetu is not the employer for jobs listed on the platform and does not make hiring decisions on behalf of employers. Apply links are intended to send you to the employer's own application page or original destination where available.

If a listing looks wrong or outdated, use Report a Job or Contact.

Hidden Jobs

Separately, Hidden Jobs are manually curated community and referral opportunities that often never appear on traditional boards. They are maintained separately from standard verified career-portal listings.

How resume optimization works

AI Resume Optimizer tailors a candidate's resume to a specific job description. You open a role, upload your resume, and HireSetu generates an ATS-oriented, job-specific version with keyword alignment and clearer structure for recruiters and applicant tracking systems.

Processing runs on HireSetu infrastructure using AI models described in our Privacy Policy. Job browsing is free; resume generation uses a free trial allocation and optional prepaid credits — see Pricing. AI Match is a guided path into that same role-focused workflow, not a guarantee of interviews.

How company analytics are generated

Company profiles and hiring signals are derived from live job listings HireSetu has published after editorial review — not from paid company placements. Metrics such as active openings, hiring velocity, growth vs a prior period, and last activity timestamps come from published career-page listings and their refresh history.

Skill and location patterns on profiles reflect what appears in those openings. Counts update as new jobs are published after review. This is sample-based employer intelligence from public career portals — useful for shortlisting targets, not a paid ranking system. Explore Companies to see it in practice.

How HireSetu differs from LinkedIn, Indeed, or Naukri

Large job boards and professional networks are useful — but they often mix employer posts, recruiter promotions, and third-party listings. HireSetu is narrower and more transparent by design:

  • Transparent sourcing workflow: technology-assisted discovery, human selection, and review before publication — with apply links meant to land on employer destinations where available.
  • Career tools beyond listings: company hiring profiles and AI Resume Optimizer help candidates research employers and tailor applications — not only browse openings.
  • Company analytics from live openings: hiring signals are computed from published job listings, not paid “featured employer” placements.
  • Application tools: AI Resume Optimizer helps tailor resumes to a specific role; we do not promise interviews or placement.
  • No consultancy spam as “verified”: dubious third-party urgent-hiring posts are not treated as verified career-portal jobs.

What HireSetu offers

A complete career platform — discovery, learning, company intelligence, and AI assistance.

Industry-first job discovery

Browse verified openings by field, then search and filter across the full database.

Company hiring profiles

Active jobs, velocity signals, and recent activity from employer career pages.

Freshers, internships & walk-ins

Special categories for entry-level, student, and on-site hiring drives.

Hidden Jobs

Curated opportunities from community and referral channels often missed elsewhere.

AI Resume Optimizer & AI Match

Role-tailored resumes with ATS-friendly structure and keyword alignment.

Our principles

Official career portals first

Verified discovery is grounded in employer ATS pages, not unverified boards.

No fake consultancy spam

We do not invent openings or treat dubious third-party posts as verified jobs.

Practical AI assistance

Resume tools help you apply better — without promising interviews or hiring outcomes.

Organized discovery

Industry views, fresher/internship/walk-in categories, and clear apply destinations.

Transparent sourcing

Editorial standards, privacy, and pricing are documented in the Trust Center.

Expertise through clarity

Guides and resources explain how hiring works and how to prepare applications.

Connected next steps

Find jobs → optimize your resume → apply with Smart Apply.
